svg.text: A funnel (bugs-are-inevitable thesis) into a converging chain of evidence from Turing machines, cellular automata,
and formal proofs, meeting at the single idea of computational irreducibility, which then fans out into
consequences for testing, mathematics, and practical programming, looping back to reframe 'bug' as 'discovery'.
